name: Remote ACP Sessions
description: Run Claude Code sessions on remote OpenClaw nodes. Auto-deploys and manages the daemon on target nodes.

defaultNode.description: Default OpenClaw node name for remote sessions

model.description: Claude model to use for coding sessions

permissionMode.description: Permission mode for Claude Code tool execution

pollIntervalMs.description: Interval between drain polls in milliseconds

autoDeployDaemon.description: Automatically install the daemon on nodes when missing

daemonBin.description: Daemon binary command. Use a full path if the binary is not in the system.run PATH (e.g. 'C:/Users/me/nodejs/node.exe C:/Projects/node-acp/dist/index.js')

daemonStartArgs.description: Extra args passed to the daemon start command (space-separated). Default enables the web UI.

sessionMode.description: Session mode: 'persistent' keeps the claude process alive between prompts, 'ephemeral' spawns a new process per prompt

defaultNode.label: Node Name
defaultNode.help: The OpenClaw node to run Claude Code on

autoDeployDaemon.label: Auto-deploy daemon
autoDeployDaemon.help: Automatically install the daemon on nodes when not found

daemonBin.label: Daemon Binary
daemonBin.help: Full path to daemon binary or 'node /path/to/dist/index.js'. Needed when npm global bin is not in the system.run PATH (e.g. fnm/nvm users).

sessionMode.label: Session Mode
sessionMode.help: 'persistent' keeps claude alive between prompts (faster follow-ups), 'ephemeral' spawns fresh per prompt
